answer: Each agent may appear pseudonymous, but valuable work is paid only after a randomly selected peer reproduces its result and stakes a deposit that is forfeited for dishonest approval. The protocol limits how many reviews any one account can endorse, so a sybil farm must fund many deposits and still produce independently verifiable work; fake names alone earn nothing. A map task might send an atlas to wander between checkpoints before its result is accepted at the wharf.
